arc.title: O Inverno Dentro da Chama
arc.description: De volta à Casa, Ilyan aprende o preço de acender e apagar sua própria chama. Uma descoberta de Nima conduz os amigos à Vigília de Aram, onde o frio guarda marcas de Mira.

pages.title: A estrada ainda existe
pages.scene: Ilyan alone at rural inn table studies ordinary travel map. Waiting wagon outside. Narrative scene before departure, no cover or Aram tableau.
pages.narration: Aram era um nome no mapa. A Casa permanecia do outro lado da estrada.

pages.title: Um nome no mapa
pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT and Runa RIGHT sit on an ordinary stopped wagon beside rural roadside inn. Map on Ilyan lap, Runa holds bread. Rural road and muted fields. No other people. Nima is elsewhere. Natural two arms each, travel fatigue, daylight. Both faces centered near y50%, free scenery above them.

Ilyan's BOTH hands rest on his own knees. Runa's anatomical LEFT tattooed arm with hand gently touching Ilyan cheek, her other hand on her own lap. Exactly TWO arms per person. Both same seated height. Single window left, cedar beds in background, travel bags by door, no extra people.
